protocol_limits.grid: Fig. 4 shows its plotted range but does not specify exact sampling coordinates. This independent grid covers 10–50 microseconds and 1.35–1.61 MHz.

protocol_limits.temperature: Vacuum chosen for operational loss; the figure captions do not state the occupation vector.
